commands.name: browser
commands.description: Browser shortcuts: navigate | screenshot | dom | url.

commands.name: call
commands.description: Invoke any shaft-mcp tool by name.

commands.name: capture
commands.description: Capture shortcuts: start | stop | status | code | step-delete | step-reorder. Start auth reuse: loadStoragePath / saveStoragePath / userDataDirectory (CLI --load-storage / --save-storage / --user-data-dir).

commands.name: codegen
commands.description: Generate SHAFT fluent Java only from a capture recording (deterministic, no MCP session; --target is metadata only).

commands.name: design
commands.description: Design shortcuts: ingest | analyze | gherkin | examples | lexicon | coverage | lint | gap-map | readiness | handoff.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Doctor shortcuts: analyze | suggest | local-ai-status | cause-label.

commands.name: help
commands.description: When no COMMAND is given, the usage help for the main command is displayed. If a COMMAND is specified, the help for that command is shown.

commands.name: report
commands.description: Reporting shortcuts: open, summary, history, flake, tags, clusters, heal, mute, unmute, mutes.

commands.name: session
commands.description: Manage the shaft-mcp daemon session (start | status | stop).

commands.name: setup
commands.description: Plan and manage SHAFT-owned local infrastructure.

commands.name: tools
commands.description: List the tools exposed by shaft-mcp.
